name: American Throne
source:
In an alternate history, romance and chivalry sweep across the American continents as kings and queens wage wars for the ultimate throne—the American Throne.

Investigate potential subversion along the European frontier. Such is the mission that high-ranking Praetor Quinn Smith and her captain Nathan Barnes are given by the Senate in distant Ottawa, Canada. A false mission that Quinn believes is a plot to purge her from the political heart of the Republic of Canada. Thwarted by her political enemies, the determined and driven Quinn intends to make a name for herself in Europe before she sails back to the Americas and campaigns for the highest political rung possible—the office of the Consul.

Deep in France, she reacquaints with the mild-mannered yet disturbing Commander Beckett Morrison, who offers her a once in a lifetime opportunity that delivers her ever closer to her aspiration. Ambitious as ever, Quinn accepts and sets herself on a path that unintentionally reveals her most powerful trump card, a secret she has never told anyone. A secret that she stole from the formidable ruler, lords, and knights of the Kingdom of the United States of America.

[From the [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/american-throne/id1560449049]App Store page[/url]]
translation:
在一段架空历史中，浪漫与骑士精神席卷美洲大陆。国王与女王们为至高的王座展开战争——那便是美洲王座。

调查欧洲边境可能存在的颠覆活动。这是加拿大遥远的渥太华参议院交给高级裁判官奎因·史密斯以及她的队长内森·巴恩斯的任务。奎因认为，这是一项虚假的使命，是将自己清除出加拿大共和国政治核心的阴谋。遭到政敌阻挠，意志坚定、野心勃勃的奎因打算先在欧洲闯出名声，再启航返回美洲，角逐自己所能企及的最高政治职位，执政官。

在法国腹地，她与温文尔雅却令人不安的指挥官贝克特·莫里森重逢。对方向她提出一个千载难逢的机会，能让她离抱负更近一步。始终满怀野心的奎因接受了提议，踏上一条道路，却意外暴露了自己最强大的王牌。那是一个从未向任何人提起的秘密，一个她从美利坚合众王国强大的统治者、领主与骑士手中窃取的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/american-throne/id1560449049]App Store页面[/url]]
